passages.locator: Introducing the Kirin 990 5G; Kirin 990 5G: 5G Application Processor/Modem
passages.note: The analysts identify the base N7 FinFET in the earlier 4G models and the N7+ EUV FinFET in the 5G models that began shipping in China on 1 November. They report inspection of a Mate 30 Pro 5G.
